notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:
Necroking has officially emerged from the shadows and is now live on Windows and macOS! 

The world is crumbling under chaos. Cities are rotting and the living dare to stand in your way. But fear not, because you are the Necroking – master of the undead, wielder of dark magic, and bringer of doom. It’s time to raise your army and show the world what real power looks like! 

[previewyoutube=mZ1W5iGz0MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What awaits you in Necroking:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Become the Death Monarch.[/b] Command over 30 unique undead minions and crush anyone who stands against you. 
[*] [b]Vast Skull Deckbuilding. [/b]Customize your deck, unlock powerful unites, and devastate your enemies. 
[*] [b]4 diverse biomes.[/b] Each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
[*] [b]King’s Secret. [/b]Unravel the mystery of the King as you journey through a dark, twisted story. 
[/list]
You can already play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads, and we’re hard at work on adding full controller and Steam Deck support in upcoming updates. Stay tuned and join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to keep up with all the news!

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and leave feedback on Necroking – we can’t wait to hear what you think: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Hello, robinsons!

The VAST Corporation keeps on perfecting the base.

This update contains:
[list]
[*] Improved tutorial
[*] Improved descriptions of the machines
[*] Now you need to spend fewer crystals to unlock upgrade units
[*] Botanical Unit becomes available right after Desert-lvl3
[*] Your death is not a waste: now you will gain experience after death and skill points after level-ups
[*] Improved gamepad controls
[*] Optimization, fine-tuning, delicate polishing
[/list]

Go Robinsons!

notes.title: Great Update

tags.bug: [*] Now invisible enemies from the jungle become visible even if they were killed in an invisible state;
[*] Now the Dog doesn't forget to attack the boss.

tags.feature: [*] Added timer of current run in the upper right;

tags.balance_change: [*] Some monsters (see the pic below) changed their attack sound so that you'll be able to distinguish it from other enemies shots.

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content:
Ethan is a wrench expert and is able to fix everything!

What was fixed:

[list]
[*] passing through walls at low FPS
[*] freezing in the battle with the boss on the 3rd stage 
[*] problem with text in dialogues at low FPS 
[*] camera shake after killing the boss and returning to the base
[*] now after clearing the sector, the teleport is waiting for you fully charged
[/list]

You go, robinsons!
